wins: Mapped internal subnet effectively with masscan before hitting firewall rate limits
Captured service banners from multiple hosts allowing quick prioritization (SSH, HTTP)
Documented reachable assets, enabling clear pivot plan despite no full compromise
fails: SSH brute-force attempts stalled due to aggressive account lockout; no credential validation
Exploit payloads failed to execute because target environment patched assumed CVE
No persistence achieved due to lack of shell on discovered hosts
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase yielded solid visibility, but exploitation stalled; next focus should be tailored credential ops and validated exploit chains.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Brute-force SSH without valid credential lists leads to account lockouts and 0% success

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with headers
skill_cards.then_action: Use gobuster directory scan followed by nikto for vuln feedback

skill_cards.if_condition: When multiple services are discovered with different patch levels
skill_cards.then_action: Cross-reference CVEs using searchsploit and prioritize newest high-severity

memory_ops.reason: High yield in reconnaissance phase with validated SSH banners
